subject: Health and Physical Education Curricula Review
overview: The Curriculum Subcommittee met to review the Medford Public Schools K–12 health education and physical education curricula and discuss departmental goals.

items.title: Health Education Curriculum Review
items.summary: Director of Physical Education and Health Education Rachel Perry presented the district's K–12 health curriculum based on the Michigan Model, after which committee members raised questions regarding puberty education, gender identity, and consent.

items.title: Physical Education Curriculum Review
items.summary: Perry detailed the physical education curriculum across grade levels, highlighting motor skill progression in elementary and middle schools as well as high school electives like lifeguard training and CPR certification.

items.title: Department Priorities and Next Steps
items.summary: Perry presented future departmental goals, including proposals for middle school health and adaptive PE staff, updated professional development, and evaluating the FLASH curriculum for special education students.
